venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: High in the 90s, mixed clouds and sun; lows mid 70s
venues.narrative: **CC ATL — Tuesday, July 21, 2026** — MOD MKZ // JK. Quiet right at open but picked up around 5pm as folks came in for Bingo Night; 14 total Meal Deals. Lots of repeat guests redeeming Bingo Credits. Lined bar, all booths sat and a full Mezz by 6:30/7pm; thinned out just after 8pm with after-dinner drinks the rest of the night. Opener cut at 8:30pm; closer went home ill just before 10pm and MOD handled the close with barback support. Smooth last call, everyone out by 12am. Kitchen: lots of to-go food. 86 Classic City Lager. Comps $100.08 (Bingo Credits, F&F, Industry Love). Favorite moment: meeting Kelsey and Trevor, repeat guests from CC Nashville who live close by. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Tuesday, July 21, 2026** — MOD KK / Chef JMS. Solid Tuesday night, beating target. Decent push soon after open with a modest service size through Bingo; volume increased noticeably at 8:45pm and held until ~10:15pm. Industry guests after 11pm, notably Thomas and others from O-ku. John Michael held down the kitchen and was present on the floor. Comps $63.20 / 4.1% (Bingo Credit, Manager Comp, Industry). 86: CO2, Pet Nat Paloma, Taco Tuesday. Favorite moment: introducing BT to the Bingo regulars. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tuesday, July 21, 2026** — AM MOD Carey; PM MOD Maggie H & Rachel. DC/AM sales $1,106.63; D&C (PM) $7,399.60; total net $8,506.23 vs $9,235 target. Events: day 2 of High School Success meetings, 25 guests 8am–3:30pm in Vauxhall with breakfast & lunch spread from Josh — net event sales $4,404 (event food $3,510), bringing total net including events to $12,910.23. PM notes: rough night — service suffered at Marquee and filtered onto the floor with a few walkouts and low tip %s; team busted their butts but stress got the best of them. AM: busy Tuesday at the cafe; need to brew cold brew and low on syrups (caramel, miel, evergreen, miso ses). Kitchen: chill night, cleaned drains and behind the lowboys; 86 scallops, mint verde, creamed spinach; low on cookie dough, honey butter, fingerlings, chicken demi, steaks. Comps $867.25. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.weather: Downpours early with tornado warnings; cleared by 7:30pm
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday, July 21, 2026** — MOD Michael + Steves. Classic Tuesday flow: incredibly slow start (downpours and tornado warnings kept guests timid), then the entire East Village came in at once after the rain ended ~7:30pm — packed and bumping 8:30–11pm including a walk-up 8-top, only a few duos on the waitlist. Mellowed by 11:30/midnight with a smooth finish. Top sellers: Shinebox #1, Native Lion #2, Quickbeam #3, Avrill & High Plains Drifter tied #4, Burner Phone #5. Two guests left because the room was too cold. Welcomed local member Saneel, investor Jessica Haff, and Gabriel from The Wayland; several birthdays and a celebration for a guest passing their doctor's exam. Kitchen: 86 oysters. Menu count 18; breakage: Pils, DOF, Nick+Nora, 2 coupes. Comps $55 (DNL + member discount). No no-shows.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Tuesday, July 21, 2026** — MOD Julian & Victor. Service started a little slow. Ruffy stopped by to say thank you for his ride at Death & Co; Oscar came in with friends who just opened a new cafe in town; one investor in for a quick one-and-done; a couple of birthdays. All guests seated and well taken care of — plenty of first-timers thanking us for having an LA location. Kitchen: one-man army killed service, food out fast, no complaints. Comps $291.50 (handful of comps, discounts, free items, late ring-ups). Maintenance: men's hand-wash faucet is loose, about to fall off. No 86s; no incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Tuesday, July 21, 2026** — MOD Marcus. Marquee bar sales $4,048.11; total net including events $3,674.54 vs $3,295 target — solid night despite the storms. Plenty of walk-ins (66 of 90 guests) though quite a few cancellations; the room filled several times and campers after the storms never impacted service. Grant handled the floor solo with Alex, Jada, and Sophia stepping out to support; bartop stayed busy and turned several times. Sophia guest-barbacked and anticipated needs proactively. Kitchen: James super helpful running food with a full room and one server. Comps $18.22 (investor). Maintenance: curtains at both server stations; service well drains. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Hot, high UV, one spotted shower late evening
venues.narrative: **MG — Tuesday, July 21, 2026** — AM MOD Justin & Lex; PM MOD Braden & Marcus. (Report's day-of-week field said Wednesday; date and post time confirm Tuesday 7/21.) Municipal Bar morning $746 (17 guests); evening $3,653 (63 guests); Sun Club $455; Hot Eye closed. Total net $4,400 vs $4,500 target. Slower morning with hotel guests trickling in; welcomed Reg to MG for lunch on the mezzanine. Slow night but killer service — Ryan and Reg sat for a full dinner and were treated to the new summer salad; cuts at 8/8:30, workflow fine without SA or BB; a good amount of hotel guests stayed past close. Sun Club: Skylar trained well but needs more drink reps; dishwasher draining on its own, may be finicky or broken. Kitchen: nothing to report; gelato 86'd until tomorrow. Comps $124. No incidents.
